rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the right-hand side or direction, such as when giving directions.

example.english: When you get to the crossroads, turn right.
example.traditional: 你去到十字路口就向右邊轉。
example.jyutping: nei5 heoi3 dou3 sap6 zi6 lou6 hau2 zau6 hoeng3 jau6 bin1 zyun2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something being correct, morally acceptable, or suitable.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 daap3 on3 ngaam1 saai3

rows.note: Use this for a legal, moral, or personal entitlement, especially in phrases about someone having or lacking a right.

example.english: You have the right to refuse this request.
example.traditional: 你有權利拒絕呢個要求。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 kyun4 lei6 keoi5 zyut6 ni1 go3 jiu1 kau4

rows.note: Use this for the right-hand side and for a rightward turn or bend, such as 右轉 or 右彎.

example.english: Turn right at the next intersection.
example.jyutping: haa6 jat1 go3 lou6 hau2 hoeng3 jau6 zyun2

rows.note: Use 就 before a location or target to mean exactly there or directly beside it.

example.english: I'll wait right at the entrance for you.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zau6 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 nei5

rows.note: For the actually or really sense, 真係 is the all-purpose spoken choice.

example.english: This shop really is a good buy, right?
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 zan1 hai6 dai2 maai5 gaa3 wo3

rows.note: Use 右 for being on or moving toward the right side, usually in a directional phrase.

example.jyutping: hoeng3 jau6 zyun2 jap6 tiu4 hong6

rows.note: Use 正確 when an action is performed correctly or properly, especially in explicit or careful wording.

example.english: Please fill in the form right.
example.jyutping: cing2 zing3 kok3 tin4 se2 biu2 gaak3 zi1 liu2

rows.note: Use this geometric description when an angle measures 90 degrees.

example.english: This angle is a right angle.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gok3 hai6 gau2 sap6 dou6

rows.note: Use this construction for a geometric figure that has a right angle, such as a right triangle.

example.english: This is a triangle with a right angle.
example.traditional: 呢個三角形係有直角嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 saam1 gok3 jing4 hai6 jau5 zik6 gok3 ge3
